title: Frontend UI (Subscription, Room Creation Wizard, Room Join/Browse, Team Allocation)
description: Implements Next.js UI for subscription management, 13-step room creation wizard, room discovery and joining, and team allocation interface. All pages responsive at 375px–1440px.

pages_created.description: Current subscription display with plan info, renewal date, features, upgrade CTA
Subscription plans listing with pricing, features, upgrade buttons (stub for Phase L payment)
Room creation wizard root page with form orchestration
Public room discovery page with search, filters, sort, join actions
Private room join page with invitation code entry
Room detail page showing configuration, members, allocation UI, start action

components_created.description: 13-step form wizard with progress indicator, validation, next/previous navigation, preview and submit
Team allocation interface supporting USER_SELECTED (dropdown), RANDOM (button), CUSTOM (placeholder)
Step 1: Room name, description, start date/time input
Step 2: PUBLIC/PRIVATE radio selection with descriptions
Step 3: Team allocation method selector (USER_SELECTED, RANDOM, CUSTOM)
Step 4: Auction control mode selector (HOST_CONTROLLED, SYSTEM_AUTOMATIC)
Step 6: Player selection mode selector (MANUAL, AUTOMATIC_DRAW)
Step 7: Team count slider (2-16), purse input, quick presets, color preview
Step 8: Dynamic player categories with name and base price inputs, add/remove buttons
Step 9: Bid increment brackets with from/to/increment inputs, presets
Step 10: Squad size min/max with presets (11-15, 10-14, 12-16)
Step 11: Break interval, duration, adjustments configuration
Step 12: Host participation toggle with explanation
Step 13: Comprehensive review of all auction settings before creation

rooms: listPublicRooms(filters) - browse public rooms with search/sort
getRoomDetail(roomId) - fetch room configuration and members
joinRoom(roomId, role) - join existing room as team owner or spectator
allocateTeam(roomId, teamId) - assign team to member (USER_SELECTED/RANDOM)
generateInvitation(roomId, params) - create invitation code (host only)
joinWithCode(code, role) - join private room with code
api_integration.types: All endpoints use type-safe DTOs from packages/contracts (SubscriptionDto, RoomDto, etc.)

patterns: Single-column on mobile, multi-column on larger screens
Responsive typography with scaling font sizes
Flexible navigation (stacked on mobile, horizontal on desktop)

features: ARIA labels for icons and dynamic content

validation.error_display: Per-step error messages with AlertCircle icon
